thread:
maria: FYI ran into a nasty combination with the python async client when our webhook consumer retried a streaming generate. ended up with duplicated side-effects and the aio loop stalling briefly :grimacing:

maria: tiny repro: inside aiohttp handler we call client.generate.stream(...) and on transient 5xx the SDK retries, but because the async adapter used blocking sleep it paused the loop, and since stream idempotency wasn't preserved the server executed twice.

maria: snippet:
```py
async def webhook(req):
    async for chunk in client.chat.stream("gpt-mini"):
        await ws.send_str(chunk.text)
```

maria: logs show backoff sleeping in the async path via time.sleep and two distinct requests with no Idempotency-Key header for the streaming call.

lee: ouch. blocking sleep in async path is a regression from early porting. can you paste the stack?

maria: stack: File ".../redwood/sdk/transport/async_retry.py", line 52, in _retry_attempt
    time.sleep(delay)  # blocking

oliver: two issues: (1) blocking sleep; (2) streaming bodies not buffered so on replay we can't reattach body and we don't send idempotency key on streams. both combine poorly.

dina: proposed plan:
- change blocking sleep -> asyncio.sleep in async transport (fast patch)
- make streaming retries opt-in with a client flag (default off)
- implement small configurable buffer for stream bodies (e.g., 32KB) to allow safe replay for short streams
- surface clear error when buffer limit exceeded instead of attempting silent replay

maria: buffering would work for our consumer (payloads small). agree this must be opt-in with docs about memory and semantics.

oliver: runtime changes needed: accept an Idempotency-Key for streaming endpoints and return 409 on duplicate to avoid double-side-effects. will add compatibility header for older runtimes.

lee: UX proposal for API:
```py
Client(api_key=..., retry=RetryPolicy(max_attempts=3, backoff="expo", async_sleep=True, stream_replay=False, stream_buffer_limit=32768))
```

lee: also add a telemetry counter metric: sdk.stream_replay_attempts and sdk.stream_replay_failures so teams can monitor accidental replays.

dina: i'll update quickstart + streaming docs to call out that replays are disabled by default and show the opt-in example. also note that streaming + side-effects is a special case and recommend server-side dedupe when possible.

maria: opened internal ticket RED-7892 with repro + logs and linked the runtime issue. (cc @lee @oliver @dina)

ci-bot: CI build passed for branch fix/async-sleep (tests cover asyncio path) :white_check_mark:

lee: i'll land the async.sleep change and tests today. followups: implement buffer logic and expose clear error for >limit, add unit + integration tests that simulate partial stream body consumption and replay.

maria: thanks all. will add an integration test that mimics our webhook flow once patches land. :thumbsup:
